cohort: The study enrolled 1072 outborn neonates with suspected sepsis referred to a pediatric emergency department at a tertiary care center.
finding: The study found a high sepsis burden and an alarming prevalence of multidrug resistance (68.6%) among isolated pathogens, particularly in Klebsiella spp. (62%), Acinetobacter spp. (83%), and coagulase-negative staphylococci (82%).
